name: wrf-benchmark-eastasia3km
description: High-resolution (3 km) WRF simulation dataset for East Asia used to benchmark spatiotemporal weather forecasting or surrogate-modeling approaches. It measures predictive skill for meteorological fields across space and time and is intended for ML model training and evaluation for weather prediction/downscaling tasks.
evaluation_method: Forecast error metrics such as RMSE / MAE / CRPS and spatial verification scores
reputation: Research-oriented dataset hosted on Hugging Face; used by a niche community of ML-for-weather researchers.
